title: Ostomy Supply Program Payment Plan Months for Customers of the Urology and Continence Supply Program
content:
Continence balances lengthen an Ostomy Supply Program payment plan. The continence balance is the running total of the patient-balance postings on all of the customer's Urology and Continence Supply Program programs: remittance patient responsibility, patient charges and refunds, less patient payments and balance adjustments.

| Customer's continence records | Months added to the number of installments |
|---|---|
| An active continence program and a continence balance above USD 0.00 | 2 (the continence-owing months) |
| An active continence program and a continence balance of USD 0.00 or less | 1 (the continence-clear month) |
| Any other customer | None |

These months are added to the number of installments.

**Cases (hypothetical).** Active continence program owing USD 0.01: 2 months. Active continence program with a USD 12.00 credit: 1 month. Continence program closed: none.
